defs.def: to tell sb that you are grateful for sth 谢谢，感谢（某人）；（为某事）道谢

ex.s: The sun-dried clothes smell especially pleasant where I live, thanks to the ____63____ (absent) of smog and plenty of blue sky ____64____ (afternoon) with lots of fresh air.
ex.t: 多亏烟雾和充满____63____新鲜空____64____气的蓝天

ex.s: What does Kathy thank Dave for?
ex.t: 凯西为什么感谢戴夫?

ex.s: As I handed him the glasses, he looked at me and said, “Thanks!”
ex.t: 当我把眼镜递给他时，他看着我说：“谢谢！”

ex.s: It’s thanks to these TV chefs rather than any advertising campaign that Britons are turning away from meat-and-two-veg and ready-made meals and becoming more adventurous in their cooking habits.
ex.t: 正是多亏了这些电视名厨，而非任何广告攻势，英国人正在远离“肉加两样蔬菜”和速食餐，在烹饪习惯上变得更大胆。

ex.s: Thanks to Beijing’s long history ____63____ capital of China, almost every hutong has its stories, and some are even associated with historic ____64____ (event).
ex.t: 得益于北京作为首都的悠久历史____63____，几乎每条胡同都有自己的故事，有些甚至与 historic ____64____（event）事件相关。

ex.s: To express thanks.
ex.t: 为了表达感激之情

ex.s: "I don't know   65   to thank him.”
ex.t: "我不知道65 感谢他。"

ex.s: Thank you for being my ray of sunshine!
ex.t: 谢谢你做我的一缕阳光！

ex.s: Simply saying thank you doesn't seem enough in certain situations.
ex.t: 简单地说,在某些情况下,谢谢你似乎还不够。

ex.s: So, whoever you are, thank you for the random act of   54   that not only helped my mother out, but   55   too.
ex.t: 所以，无论你是谁，谢谢你这次随机的____54____之举，它不仅帮了我母亲，也____55____。

ex.s: Thanks to them, a family was saved from the fire.
ex.t: 多亏了他们，一家人从火中被救出。

ex.s: Thank you for your letter, what really made me happy.
ex.t: 谢谢你的来信, 真正让我高兴的是什么。

ex.s: Instead, one activist, dressed in a full-body monkey suit, had arrived with a sign praising the filmmakers: "Thanks for not using real apes (猿)!"
ex.t: 相反，一位身着全身猴子装的活动人士举着一块称赞电影制作人的牌子出现：“感谢你们没有使用真猿！”

ex.s: To express thanks to some filmmakers.
ex.t: 为了表达对一些电影制片人的感谢.

ex.s: Thanks to the Silence Machine, a British invention, you can get rid of the sound without upsetting the boy or his parents.
ex.t: 多亏了英国发明“静音机”，你可以在不惹恼男孩或其父母的情况下消除声音。

ex.s: I became interesting in playing football thanks to a small accident.
ex.t: 多亏一次小意外，我对踢足球产生了兴趣。

ex.s: Two hours later， back at my house，I heard a knock on the door． My husband（4）     it while I was on the phone in the dining room． "Does Jennifer live here？" I heard a lady say． In my husband's hand was my wallet， with not a penny（5）     ． She left before I could （6）      make it to the door to offer my thanks．
ex.t: 两小时后，回到家中，我听到敲门声。我丈夫（4）_____应了门，当时我在餐厅打电话。“詹妮弗住这儿吗？”我听到一位女士说。我丈夫手里是我的钱包，一分钱（5）_____都没少。我还没来得及（6）_____走到门口道谢，她就走了。

ex.s: After sharing the story online， I heard from someone，who（7）     the lady as Erin Smith． Without（8）     ，I called to thank her． She said she （9）     my wallet on a bus seat． She （10）     that going to a stranger's house was a（11）      move， but she decided to take the chance． "If I were in that（12）     ． I would want someone to try to find me，"she said．
ex.t: 在网上分享这个故事后，有人联系我，他（7）_____那位女士是艾琳·史密斯。我（8）_____地打电话感谢她。她说她（9）_____我的钱包在公交车座位上。她（10）_____去陌生人家里是个（11）_____的举动，但她决定抓住机会。“如果我处在那种（12）_____。我会希望有人试着找到我，”她说。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: Thank you for your time．
ex.t: 谢谢您的时间。

ex.s: By the end of the century，if not sooner，the world's oceans will be bluer and greener thanks to a warming climate，according to a new study.
ex.t: 一项新研究显示，到本世纪末（若非更早），由于气候变暖，世界海洋将变得更蓝更绿。

ex.s: “I just want to say thank you,” he said.
ex.t: “我只想说谢谢你,”他说。

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: The pair were later able to thank Mr Smith for his    25   .
ex.t: 两人后来得以向史密斯先生为他的____25____致谢。

ex.s: The head of the language school told the local newspaper that the school is going to send Harvold on a weekend   53    to Dublin with a friend, thanking him for his    54   .
ex.t: 语言学校的校长告诉当地报纸，学校将送哈罗德和朋友去都柏林度周末____，以感谢他的____。

ex.s: Lisa, thank you for coming to share your suggestions for high school with us.
ex.t: 丽莎 谢谢你来跟我们分享你高中时的建议

ex.s: Well, thanks again for coming to speak to us, Lisa.
ex.t: 嗯，再次感谢你来给我们演讲，丽莎。

ex.s: Thanks to advances in technology, how we make friends and communicate with them has changed significantly.
ex.t: 得益于技术进步，我们交友和与之沟通的方式已显著改变。

ex.s: Thanks to this, Dad has come to love hot pot!
ex.t: 多亏了这个,爸爸才喜欢火锅!

ex.s: Traditionally, it was a chance to give thanks for a good harvest.
ex.t: 传统上,这是一个感谢丰收的机会。
